hypotheses.M1_high_contribution_matched: On high-active sites, the own core exceeds a same-support-size, contribution-matched, exactly write-norm-matched control by at least 0.15 in each OOD corpus.
hypotheses.M2_high_random_matched: On high-active sites, the own core exceeds the median same-support-size random changed-feature control by at least 0.15 in each OOD corpus.
hypotheses.M3_category_consistency: The own core beats the contribution-matched control in at least four of five category medians in each OOD corpus.
hypotheses.M4_random_active_specificity: On random-active sites, the own core exceeds the contribution-matched control by at least 0.10 in each OOD corpus.
